## 1. OPEN — pick these up first

### O-P1. The portal leak is NOT fixed on the default path
**Owner-reported symptom, still reproducible:** with `?portalPunch` (default-ON) you can
see building interiors through intervening walls.

State: root-caused, code landed, **parked and not exercisable**.
* Root cause is architectural, not the sidedness predicate and not `punchSidedness`.
  `visible_portal_apertures_flat` selects every outdoor-facing portal of every
  frustum-visible EnvCell, with no reachability and no building occluder — only a
  terrain-heightfield LOS march that by construction cannot see buildings. We punch all
  of them in ONE pass, after the world pass, `depthFunc=Always`. Retail earns its
  `DEPTHTEST_ALWAYS` three ways we don't have: `PView::ConstructView`
  (`acclient.c:462423-462462`) seeds `cell_todo_list` from the camera's OWN cell and grows
  it only through `ClipPortals`; each building's punch+interior draws in that building's
  own back-to-front pass; and there is an outright Z-wipe at `:461484`.
* The landed gate (`?portalStencil`, DEFAULT OFF) double-draws the punch mesh reusing the
  MARK/RESET pair from the retired `portal_stencil.js`. It can only ever punch a SUBSET of
  what it punched before, so it structurally cannot make a visible interior vanish.
* **⚠ `?portalStencil=on` currently makes the punch feed inert (`offered/kept 0/0`).**
  The gate is reachable but does nothing. **That is the first thing to fix.**

Why it cannot be a `depthFunc` flip: the punch **writes** `gl_FragDepth`, and a written
`gl_FragDepth` is also the compared value — `LessEqual` would compare FAR and reject
everywhere. Don't re-derive this.

`url-flags.md`'s standing "never depth-test the punch" doctrine does NOT reach this gate:
it is about terrain occluding sunken interiors, and terrain-occluded apertures are already
culled upstream by `clipAperturesForPunch` (`dropped.terrain`). The only occluders this
newly rejects are walls and statics.

**Not proven:** a clean matched *daylight* before/after at town distance. The best
before/after pair (blue bleed sheets gone, interiors still rendering) is a NIGHT pair.

The E-RELIEF eye pair was **not shot**; the portal work consumed the 1070 session.
It is now cleanly assertable because `__diag.geometry.relief.variantRowsResident` was

Needs: matched ON/OFF on the real GPU with `variantRowsResident > 0` asserted, **plus a
frame-cost delta** — the flip should not be judged on looks alone. Do not flip it from an
agent; it is a migration event and the owner's call.

### O-P3. Cloud settings at ultra — A/B not run
`cloudQuality=ultra`, `cloudShadowStrength=2.5` (default 2.0), `cloudShadowRes=1024` were
judged better-looking in one eye session on one rig. **Not landed**, deliberately: a 1024
cascade is 4× the 512 shadow map and ultra is where headroom is thinnest. Needs a matched
A/B **with frame costs** before it goes into the ultra preset in `scene3d/index.js`.

### O-P4. `orch/s13-oracle` — real bug, unverified, unmerged
`3f57d9ed`: `apply_inventory_object_create` does a raw `world.entities.insert` with no
local-player guard, so ACE re-sending the player's own ObjectCreate replaces the player
entity with the public-weenie baseline, bypassing `upsert_entity_from_create`. Its own
commit message says **NOT VERIFIED**. It edits `src/lib.rs`, where a wasm ABI changed
today. Verify and rebuild before merging; do not hand-merge blind.

### O-P5. DEC-17 wants a live look
The pending-animations queue changes *when* a queued gesture plays (a second gesture
arriving mid-gesture now QUEUES instead of cutting the first off). Tests can't judge it.
Watch for the two documented deviations: when the collapse target is the in-flight head the
NEWCOMER is dropped, and pending is capped at 3 (retail is unbounded), so a burst of >3
visibly loses some — by design.

### O-P6. E4 residual
The transport carries the autonomy bit (the row holds the full `packed_sequence`; JS masks
`& 0x7fff`). The gap is a missing **consumer** — nothing downstream keys off autonomy. The
bit is pinned through the channel by a test; inventing a consumer was deliberately declined.

## 2. TRAPS — paid for today, do not pay again

* **`git stash` / `git checkout -- <path>` / `reset --hard` / `clean` / `checkout <branch>`
  are BANNED in the shared tree.** The git root is the OUTER repo
  `/home/wbterminal/WorldBuilder-ACME-Edition` — `external/holtburger/` is not a separate
  repository, so all agents share one index and one working tree, and any of these reverts
  *other people's* uncommitted work. §L4b's old "re-measure with `git checkout --`"
  instruction is what destroyed work today (P1). **Use `scripts/parity-ab.sh`** — throwaway
  worktree at a clean ref. `parity-ab.sh --tree` lists foreign uncommitted paths and refuses.
* **Suite counts are only meaningful on a quiesced tree.** Three different pass counts
  (241/242/243) circulated today. The 241 was `parity-ab.sh` under-provisioning:
  `tests/soa_aos_parity.test.cjs` requires `../pkg-node/holtburger_web.js` and `pkg-node/`
  is GITIGNORED, so a fresh worktree dies MODULE_NOT_FOUND. Patched. Record **named failing
  tests**, never bare counts.
* **`pkg/` release shape is ~6.68 MB, not ~4.5 MB.** MEMORY.md's 4.5 MB figure is STALE
  (`src/lib.rs` is now 3.1 MB / 63k+ lines). A dev build is ~18 MB and RETAINS the custom
  `name` section; wasm-opt's fingerprint is that section being gone. Two sessions were lost
  to reading a correct release build as broken.
* **A default-OFF flag can still cost the default path.** `77957842` gated its *feature*
  correctly but made default-ON `?portalPunch` allocate a composer stencil, flipping the
  shared depth texture to packed `DepthStencilFormat`/`UnsignedInt248Type` and blacking out
  distant views (mean luma **2.3 vs 62** at orbit d=80; d=30 unaffected at 119 vs 121).
  It shipped to master for ~20 minutes. **Check what the gate's *allocation* costs, not just
  what its code path does.**
* **`pass.enabled = false` is NOT a valid isolation** — `atmosphere_pipeline` re-derives
  those enables every frame. An isolation done that way is inconclusive.
* **The sky pin fails silently.** `[skytime] pinned` appeared in one arm's log and not the
  other's, invalidating a whole A/B pair. `bootpin.mjs` (in `/mnt/wbterminal2/eye1070-20260813/`)
  gates on the pin actually taking. Also: `setSkyTimeOverride` is a **persistent one-shot** —
  call it once and time-of-day is locked for the session.
* **The buildbox is SPOT-capacity-starved** (`us-central1-b`, NOT `-a` — `fleet-runbooks.md`
  is stale). It was preempted twice today and never gave a stable session. The laptop rig is
  strictly better for movement/protocol work: **no WAN in the loop**, so O9's 85 ms
  contamination does not apply.
* **Accounts:** `agentp07`=421, `agentp08`=422, `agentp09`=423 ("Probe 3650", 61 logins),
  `agentp10`=424 — **all four exist**, accessLevel 4, live characters. `agentp09`'s
  "connect failed: timeout" was a **transport/wsbridge** problem, not a missing account; it
  was wrongly written off for most of the session. **`tailnet1` is the OWNER'S — never use
  it**, whatever `scripts/perf-worker/*.mjs` hardcodes. Junk row in auth: id 429
  `agentp08account=agentp07` (a malformed URL query passed as a username).
* **Cross-agent messaging is unreliable.** Four of seven agents had `SendMessage` but no
  `ListAgents`, and their sends bounced. Route coordination through the orchestrator, or
  use the append-only `ACTIVE-LANES.md` (a courtesy, not a lock).
